user.title: Wattson
user.description: Wattson watches your main power meter, tells you when a heavy load would trip it, and learns your appliances by themselves.

data_description.power_entity: The sensor that measures the whole house. The biggest one is proposed.
data_description.limit_kw: The power in your contract: 3, 4.5, 6 kW, or type yours.
data_description.price_eur_kwh: From your bill. Used for € in summaries.
data_description.notify_entity: Where Wattson writes to you (e.g. Telegram or the mobile app). Empty = no messages.
data_description.catalog_share: Appliances you measure with a plug (type, brand, model, power; nothing about your home) go to the shared catalog on GitHub, so other homes recognise them. Needs a free GitHub account.

github.title: Link GitHub
github.description: Open {url}, sign in and type the code **{code}**. Then come back here and press Submit.

error.gh_pending: GitHub hasn't received the code yet: type it at the link, then press Submit again.
error.gh_expired: The code expired or was refused: here is a new one.
error.gh_offline: GitHub can't be reached right now. Try again later, or turn sharing off for now.
